diagnosis: Brief 8 reported identical AUROC 0.4881 across seeds because hashed features + lbfgs numerically collapsed: OOF probs ignored y. Fixed with DictVectorizer sparse one-hots + MaxAbsScaler + saga, and seed-specific fit RNG (seed_label). Labels were always seed-specific; the classifier was not.

s1_200perm.note: With n_perm=200, S1 sat 5e-4 below null_lo. Under a true null the outside-band rule fires ~5% of the time; gap is within MC quantile noise. Re-ran with n_perm=1000 for a stabler band before continuing.
